goal: Measurement and testing of machine learning systems.
criteria: An explicit comparison, metric with a useful definition, test setup or concrete failure analysis I can apply.

cases.text: Before comparing two classifiers, freeze the same test rows and label definitions. Record precision and recall at the threshold you will actually deploy. Inspect false positives separately from false negatives, since their costs differ. Keep the final test set separate from threshold tuning.

Before painting a wooden shelf, clean and sand the surface. Remove dust, apply a suitable primer and let it dry before adding paint. Several thin coats are easier to control than one thick coat.

To compare model latency, keep hardware, batch size and input lengths fixed. Warm up both models before timing, include device synchronization where required, and repeat the runs. Report a distribution rather than only the fastest observation; one unusually quick run can hide tail delays.
